supporting_observations.claim: The repeated HTTPS activity from approximately 13:40 to 14:10 UTC is to update.stockpilot.com, an approved StockPilot update service whose expected check interval is about five minutes.

Sysmon identifies the initiating process as the installed StockPilot updater, stockpilotupd.exe (PID 4108), and network telemetry corroborates its connections through the proxy to the approved update service.

Successful checks are spaced roughly five minutes apart: 13:40:41, 13:45:59, 13:50:21, 13:55:20, 14:05:54, and 14:10:40 UTC. A check at 14:00:16 received proxy status 407 (authentication required), rather than a successful tunnel.
The 13:33:37 HTTPS connection was to www.office.com and is a separate observed connection; it does not account for the repeated StockPilot update checks.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels for the StockPilot checks; the available records do not expose the encrypted application payload.
The listed winsec and Sysmon collection outage applies to WS-RMOSS-01 from 13:25 to 14:00 UTC, not WS-EBROOKS-01. No collection outage for the alerted host is specified.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not independently verify the StockPilot updater binary's hash, signature, or provenance.
The cause of the proxy authentication-required response at 14:00:16 UTC is not established.
The contents or integrity of data exchanged inside successful HTTPS tunnels are not established by these records.
unrelated_findings: The Cisco AnyConnect VPN UI was launched on WS-EBROOKS-01, although the inventory says the organization has no VPN. The records show the UI and a signed Cisco DLL load, but do not establish a VPN connection; review separately. (T206-00194, T206-00195, T206-00196)

UserAssist records indicate use of mstsc.exe and PowerShell on WS-EBROOKS-01. These records do not establish the commands, purpose, or outcome; review separately and do not treat them as evidence against the StockPilot alert. (T206-00127, T206-00187, T206-00330)

FILE-BLU-01 made a connection attempt to WS-EBROOKS-01 on TCP port 9997 that ended with RST. This is outside the alerted outbound HTTPS activity and should be reviewed separately. (T206-00283, T206-00285)
